chapter: Looking back, big bands and sidemen
title: Why few black students join school big bands
summary: Herman sees mostly white kids in high school bands, perhaps from lack of black teachers, and notes Basie and Ellington do not run seminars.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: Becoming a teacher: jazz in schools and conservatories

blocks.x: Do you have any feelings about why this problem is the way it is now?

I really don't. I do know, though, just by looking around us at the high school level, and I find that the majority of players, no matter what part of the country it is, and the kids that are really enthusiastic about it, are the white kids. And I don't know the reason. Maybe they become more enthusiastic because they're into the feeling of the big band sound, I'm not sure.

But I think a great deal of that is, I think, is, the motivation is caused and made possible by the teaching staff, the people that are involved in the teaching. And maybe there aren't enough black teachers to begin with.

Yeah. I was at a NAGE executive board meeting a couple of weeks ago, and several members of the Association's advisory council are black and they showed up, and echoed something that I had heard in the last couple of years, that even the Jazz Education Association isn't able to dispel this feeling that you have big bands in jazz education and that's what it's about, and that we ought to emphasize the other by virtue of placing emphasis more on improvisation. It might happen. That's what the blacks were saying.
And they were deploring the fact, too.

Well, then, too, I don't think there's been a great deal of enthusiasm displayed by the two black bands that are successful, reasonably successful, in this country, in -- I've not ever known Basie to hold a seminar or do any of the things that some of us have been doing for quite a few years.
And I don't hear much about the Ellington band being involved in it. So, now, whether it's their reasoning that for some purpose or nonpurpose that this
most cases they are basically glorified rehearsal bands, and -- who on occasion play some engagements.
